title: Consolidate health rollup into scoring::score_workspace
description: Add score_workspace(db) -> WorkspaceHealth to health::scoring, replacing the triplicated rollup in pipeline.rs compute_snapshot_health, file_health.rs build_component_scores, and orient.rs inline component health block. WorkspaceHealth carries file scores (with category deductions) and component scores (with member_count/total_nloc/instability). Pipeline serializes into snapshot rows; file_health and orient render slices. Consolidate round2 and cat_totals accumulation.
execution_record: Added score_workspace(db) -> WorkspaceHealth to health::scoring. WorkspaceHealth carries ScoredFile (file_id, score, deductions, category_totals) and ScoredComponent (component_id, name, score, member_count, total_nloc, instability). Pipeline serializes into snapshot rows, file_health renders component JSON slice, orient looks up scores and renders top findings from raw data. round2 unified into scoring module. ComponentInstability gained Clone derive. All 303+ tests pass, no new clippy warnings.

messages.author: codex
messages.text: Codex review: approve with notes. Two medium findings addressed in 2427929: (1) instability scan was unconditional — pipeline snapshots paid for import_edges scan with discarded results; fixed via include_instability bool param. (2) orient loaded memberships redundantly — now reuses comp_file_ids from WorkspaceHealth.
